However, it failed on the three most critical rubric criteria — it incorrectly concluded LrgWindowsAppManifest was in the solution, missed the configuration mismatch, and failed to connect the root cause chain. The agent spent 33 tool calls and 130 seconds but couldn't extract the key insight. Many tool calls returned empty results (evaluation properties, search queries) and the agent didn't adapt its approach to dig deeper into why the file was missing from that specific path. The final root cause offered was speculative and incorrect.
